a_husk_delegate_load.reconciliation: NO SPLIT — husk loaded the delegate and wrote pixels with and without --indie on this build/license. The 336-338 2026-07-17 failure does not reproduce on this build — no flag-dependent split exists here; the argv recorded per variant is the new ground truth.

b_node_render_background.implication: node.render() stays synchronous even in background mode on this build

c_completion_signal.recommendation: husk-level husk_postframe sentinel is the pixel-accurate signal (fires after the EXR lands); file-exists poll on return is the acceptable fallback ONLY when soho_foreground makes render() synchronous. Under a true background return, file-exists poll PLUS sentinel (or poll loop) is required — return-immediately carries no completion guarantee.
